description: Huawei 4G CPE 5s: 1×100M. Wi-Fi 5, 2.4 GHz 300M. The 195 Mbps cellular uplink is a radio, not a socket - it resolves to the cellular cage and cannot be cabled. Single-band 2.4 GHz radio: the spec page lists no 5 GHz rate. Requested in #150; figures from https://consumer.huawei.com/en/routers/4g-cpe-5s/specs/
